ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution across ~97% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized scar clusters and the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation field with discrete, high-contrast circular white blobs (3-10 pixel diameter) scattered across both lobes, with higher density observed in the distal regions and along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated aperture of 85-95 degrees and a bounding box depth representing approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits four distinct deep notches between the notch and the tip. Right lobe exhibits smaller, more uniform jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges with a positive upward sweep, tapering to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (~20-30 discrete points) scattered across the dark ventral surface, consistent with barnacle attachment signatures.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular erosion and jagged loss of material at the distal tip of the left lobe; widespread white circular depigmented points across the dark field.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive dark-field pigmentation (Type 5 classification) covering the entire visible ventral area except for acquired marks.
